task.title: Activate the current-dev PostgreSQL Lifecycle writer and reader
task.head_binding: The reviewer must bind this committed manifest to the exact final PR head in the canonical approve command.

not_changing: docker-compose.yml or deployment workflows (reserved for LIFECYCLE-PROJ-RETIRE-001 under SD-LIFE-03)
legacy JSON file deletion (reserved for LIFECYCLE-PROJ-RETIRE-001 under SD-LIFE-03)

contracts.relational_writer: LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_WRITER_BACKEND=postgres activates RelationalLifecycleProjector with ProjectionStore DML DSN, atomic batch transactions, contiguous checkpoints, and zero JSON generation or temp file writes.
contracts.relational_reader: PANTHEON_BFF_TRADE_JOURNEY_READER_BACKEND=postgres in BFF serves events SSE cursor, governed actions, list, detail, stages, loop runs, attention, SLO metrics/incidents, and historical replay exclusively from PostgreSQL with zero JSON fallback, evaluating complete bounded collections across all (>200) journeys and deriving stage timing from timeline events.
contracts.readiness: BFF _lifecycle_projector_dependency reports authoritative postgres writer/reader status, controller scope, exact deployment SHA; derives writer_backend=postgres from live relational controller freshness when LIFECYCLE_PROJECTOR_WRITER_BACKEND is unset in BFF compose environment; and fails closed when writer_backend!=postgres, or for unready/stale/backlog/quarantine conditions.
contracts.backfill_watermark_invariant: _backfill derives and passes source_high_watermark from input records, ensuring checkpoint <= source_high_watermark invariant holds and backlog reaches 0 when complete.
contracts.fail_closed: Missing DSN when postgres backend is selected raises RuntimeError immediately rather than falling back silently.

validation.coverage: full trade_journey suite with live postgres integration covering ProjectionStore contiguous checkpoints, incremental materializer, lifecycle projector, BFF postgres reader endpoints (including SSE events cursor and governed actions in postgres mode), and >200 journey attention/SLO regression tests
BFF relational reader endpoints, postgres readiness dependencies, >200 journeys attention/SLO tests, events cursor, governed actions, and trade journey contract validation
relational projector backend configuration, healthcheck, backfill watermark invariants, mode transitions, and zero JSON writes
compose and deploy contract alignment for operator-bff and loop-run-projector-scheduler, including rendered compose readiness regression test
